title: Coração em Dois Tempos
overview: Amid the excitement of the FIFA World Cup and the vibrant tradition of Brazil's June Festivals, Marina and Pedro must balance their dreams, family, and love. Set in Brazil's Federal District, "Coração em Dois Tempos" is a romantic comedy that celebrates Brazilian folk culture, the June Festival movement, and the nation's passion for football, showing how these traditions strengthen bonds and bring people together.
